svg.title: Loire Valley study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Middle Loire; 2: Upper Loire; 3: Savennières; 4: Saumur; 5: Montlouis-sur-Loire; 6: Chinon; 7: Bourgueil; 8: Pouilly-sur-Loire; 9: Menetou-Salon; 10: Orléans; 11: Rennes; 12: Nantes

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
